title: factory report --windows --json
description: What `factory report <initiative> --windows [--days <n>] --json` (~/claudecode/scripts/factory/report.py) prints: the autonomous windows to pick from (organizer thread 01M604KP815DSNCYV627X593NZ, lf57's window picker, run-report Amendment 2). Writer: Hephaistos (factory). Reader: Deltagos (organizer lf57), which passes a picked window back as `factory report <initiative> --since @<since> --until @<until> --json` (kind given). Times: epoch ints in seconds; *_iso and `generated` are the same times as ISO 8601 with the writer's local offset, for display only. The windows come from the factory's away digest (away-log.jsonl and away-archive/), so they are the factory's, the same for every initiative; `moved` and `moves` are this initiative's. The sample is expected-windows.json for the fixture make-fixture.sh builds (case.json `windows`).

root.description: As in factory-report.schema.json; ignored by the contract test.

from.description: now - days * 86400, epoch s: a window is listed when its until is at or after it.

windows.description: Newest first (by since): every autonomous window that ended with until >= from, and the one on now (kind current) when autonomous mode is on. [] when none.

until.description: Window end, epoch s (for kind current: now).

kind.description: The same values as factory-report.schema.json window.kind: autonomous = a window that ended; current = the one on now, up to now.

source.description: away-log.jsonl, away-archive/ (an ended window) or away (the state file, kind current).

moved.description: Whether the initiative had a move in the window: a card added under working-on/done/ (the same count as factory-report progress.denominator.count for that window).

moves.description: How many cards moved to done/ in it.
